caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, specifically an eye bolt with a nut. The eye bolt is horizontally oriented, with the circular eye on the right side and the threaded end with a hexagonal nut on the left. The metal shows signs of rust and corrosion, with a mottled texture and coloration that includes browns, reddish hues, and grayish-blue areas, particularly around the eye and along the shaft. The nut is angular and rough in texture, colored similarly with a combination of rust-brown and some gray tones. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and there are no additional objects or patterns present. The object is centrally positioned with ample empty space surrounding it, and the artist’s signature appears in small writing below and slightly to the right of the object.
title: Eye Bolt
